note: Family A — AMPLITUDE, with foot thrust back on. The owner raised spine joint 7's cap from 22 to 28 degrees, which removes the choke point that made 56 of 80 samples clip: the mid-body now runs 28/28/28/30/30 and the binding joint moves forward to joint 2 at 23 degrees. So this family pushes the wave BIGGER (higher muscle gain, less tail cut) toward a uniform ~22 degrees, and sweeps thrust gain across it. Thrust is a force, not a constraint, so it should not move the bend numbers — gain 0 anchors are included so that claim is measured rather than assumed. GAIN AXIS CORRECTED: the first run of this family used gains 8/16/28 taken from the slider bounds and the body launched (83 units in 12 s, head isolation overpowered). Calibration on shape A found the usable range to be 0-6 N per foot, where 4 already gives 2.85 u/s. Those first two family runs are void on the thrust axis; their gain-0 rows remain valid.
